text: I want to move the build off the laptop this week
Fair. Which parts can run remotely, and which need to stay local?
ok that works
Good. I will keep to that.
Just the packaging step, it steals the machine for twenty minutes
Run packaging remotely and leave the edit loop local. I would not move the tests yet.
Can you stop summarising what I already said before answering
Yes. Answer first, no restatement.
The deploy failed again on the asset upload
Upload hits the size limit before the permission check. Split it into two steps.
ok that works
Good. I will keep to that.
Did that, it got further and then timed out
Then the limit is request time, not payload. Chunk it and retry only the failed chunk.
I want the docs to stop explaining things twice
One statement per point, and delete the second when it says the same thing.
Should the cache sit in front of the database or behind the API
In front of the database. The API is cheap and the query is not.
ok that works
Good. I will keep to that.
The numbers in the report look off
They are. The total sums rows that already include the subtotal. Recompute from rows only.
Remind me why we dropped the queue
It hid failures. A dropped job looked identical to a fast one.
I keep rewriting the same intro paragraph
You rewrite the middle sentence each time. Cut it and the paragraph stops arguing with itself.
ok that works
Good. I will keep to that.
Can you get the reference numbers for the second chart
Not from the summary. They are in the raw file, so I will read it rather than guess.
The page is slow on a phone
The hero is being sent at desktop width. Serve a smaller one below 48rem.
I do not want a fallback that hides the error
Then it fails loudly and you fix the cause. A quiet fallback and a dead job look the same.
ok that works
Good. I will keep to that.
How much has the bill gone up
Nine percent, almost all storage. Compute is flat.
Add a check that stops me shipping a broken link
A link check that fails the build, not a warning. Warnings get scrolled past.
The naming is inconsistent across the two modules
Pick the one the interface already uses and rename the other. Do not invent a third.
ok that works
Good. I will keep to that.
Make the failure message say which field was wrong
Name the field and the rule. Validation failed costs a second visit.
I think the test is wrong, not the code
Read the assertion first. It expects the old order, which we changed deliberately.
Put the dark theme back, light is harsh at night
Dark after sunset, light by default. I will not ask again.
ok that works
Good. I will keep to that.
The export is missing two rows
The filter drops rows with no timestamp. Include them and label the timestamp empty.
The map flickers when I drag it
The redraw is happening per pointer move. Coalesce to one per frame.
Should I keep the old endpoint alive for a month
Only if something you cannot update calls it. Otherwise remove it and watch the logs.
ok that works
Good. I will keep to that.
The CLI takes four seconds to start
It imports the whole package for one command. Load that module lazily.
I want the error page to say what to do next
Then it needs the failing action, not the stack trace. Give the next step in one line.
